· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.6213→-5.1070) - confirmed continued bearishness and worsening.

· Swing resistance ($721.89) - resistance zone at mid-Bollinger Band and SMA50.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (sideways) - confirmed lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) - potential for buy consideration due to RSI oversold entry and proximity to support, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to continued MACD deterioration.
